say.description: Send a message as the bot in the current channel.
say.longDescription: Sends a message as the bot in the current channel.
examples:
/say message:Hello everyone!
Sends a message as the bot.

birthday.description: Manage birthdays: set, view, and delete.
examples:
/birthday set day:15 month:6
Sets the birthday to June 15.

/birthday set day:15 month:6 year:2000
Sets the date with a year.

set.longDescription: Saves the day, month, and optionally the year of your birthday.
examples:
/birthday set day:15 month:6
Sets the birthday to June 15.

/birthday set day:15 month:6 year:2000
Sets it with a year.

actions.description: Emotions and GIF interactions: hug, kiss, and more.
actions.longDescription: Sends a GIF interaction with the specified user or without one.

ping.description: Shows bot, API, database, and shard latency.
ping.longDescription: Reports the current response time and the bot's connection state.

help.description: List of available commands with description, permissions, and examples.
help.longDescription: Shows all modules and commands available on this server.
examples:
/help command:ban
Detailed information about the /ban command.

config.description: Bot configuration for the server: language, modules, logs, birthdays, and currency.
config.longDescription: Changing the server language, modules, logs, and greetings.
examples:
/config birthdays channel:#general enable:true
Configures birthday greetings.

language.longDescription: Changes the bot's language for the entire server.
examples:
/config language
Opens the language selection menu.

modules.longDescription: Manages the bot's active modules on the server.
examples:
/config modules
Opens the module selection menu.

birthdays.longDescription: Channel selection and enabling/disabling automatic greetings.
examples:
/config birthdays channel:#general enable:true
Enables greetings in #general.

logging.longDescription: Channel selection and enabling/disabling the logging system.
examples:
/config logging channel:#logs enable:true
Enables logs in #logs.

currency.longDescription: Changes the emoji and name of the economy currency.

confessions.description: Manage AI memory containers for the server's channels.
confessions.longDescription: Manages AI memory containers for channels on this server.
examples:
/confessions create channel:#general
Create an AI memory container.

/confessions block id:123
Delete a container by ID.

/confessions report id:123 reason:spam
Send the container to the owner.

create.description: Create a memory container for the channel.

report.description: Send the container to the bot owner.

about.description: Shows information about the bot, statistics, and system load.
about.longDescription: Shows statistics, load, and system information.

avatar.description: Shows the user's avatar at maximum size.
avatar.longDescription: Shows the user's avatar at maximum size.

banner.description: Shows the user's banner at maximum size.
banner.longDescription: Shows the user's banner at maximum size.

guild.description: Server information: members, boosts, owner, features.

channel.description: Channel information: category, topic, creation date.
examples:
/channel info
Shows information about the current channel.

/channel info channel:#general
Shows information about the #general channel.

info.longDescription: Shows the channel's category, topic, and creation date.
examples:
/channel info
Shows information about the current channel.

/channel info channel:#general
Shows information about the #general channel.

user.description: User information: registration date, join date, roles.
examples:
/user info user:@user
Shows information about the user.

info.longDescription: Shows the user's registration date, join date, and roles.
examples:
/user info user:@user
Shows information about the user.

roles.description: Role information: color, creation date, ID.
examples:
/roles info role:@role
Shows information about the role.

info.longDescription: Shows the role's color, creation date, and ID.
examples:
/roles info role:@role
Shows information about the role.

timestamp.description: Generate Discord timestamps in various formats.
timestamp.longDescription: Creates all Discord timestamp formats from the specified time.
examples:
/timestamp
Shows the current time in all formats.

/timestamp time:5m
Shows the time in 5 minutes.

emoji.description: View and get information about server emojis.
emoji.longDescription: View and get information about server emojis.
examples:
/emoji list
Shows the list of emojis.

/emoji info emoji:cat
Information about the emoji.

list.longDescription: Shows all server emojis with pagination.
examples:
/emoji list
Shows the list of emojis.

info.longDescription: Shows the emoji's ID, animation, and creation date.

ban.description: Ban a user from the server with a reason and message deletion.
ban.longDescription: Blocks a user on the server with optional message cleanup.
ban.deleteOption: Delete messages from the last N days (0-7).
examples:
/ban user:@user reason:flood delete_messages:7
Bans and deletes messages from the last 7 days.

/ban user:@user
Bans without specifying a reason.

unban.description: Unban a user by their ID with a reason.
unban.longDescription: Removes the ban from a user by their ID.

kick.description: Kick a user from the server with a reason.
kick.longDescription: Removes a member from the server.
examples:
/kick user:@user reason:flood
Kicks the user with a reason.

timeout.description: Apply a timeout to a user for the specified time.
examples:
/timeout user:@user duration:5m reason:flood
Timeout for 5 minutes.

/timeout user:@user duration:1h reason:spam
Timeout for one hour.

warn.description: Warning management: add, list, remove, and clear.
examples:
/warn add user:@user reason:spam
Give a warning.

add.longDescription: Adds a warning to the user.
examples:
/warn add user:@user reason:spam
Gives a warning.

list.longDescription: Shows all of the user's warnings.

remove.longDescription: Removes a specific warning by ID.

clear.description: Remove all of the user's warnings.
Delete messages in the current channel (up to 100).
examples:
/clear amount:20 user:@user
Deletes 20 messages from the user.

slowmode.description: Set slowmode in the channel (0-21600 sec).
slowmode.longDescription: Sets the interval between messages in the channel.

nickname.description: Change or reset a member's nickname.
nickname.longDescription: Sets or resets the member's nickname.

role.description: Give or remove a role from a member.
examples:
/role add user:@user role:@role
Gives the role.

/role remove user:@user role:@role
Removes the role.

add.longDescription: Adds the role to the user.
examples:
/role add user:@user role:@role
Gives the role.

remove.longDescription: Removes the role from the user.
examples:
/role remove user:@user role:@role
Removes the role.

infrastructure.longDescription: Operations with channels and other server elements.
examples:
/infrastructure channel lock
Locks the current channel.

/infrastructure channel unlock
Unlocks the current channel.

lock.longDescription: Prevents @everyone from writing in the channel.
examples:
/infrastructure channel lock
Locks the current channel.

/infrastructure channel lock channel:#general reason:flood
Locks #general with a reason.

unlock.longDescription: Removes the restriction on sending messages.
examples:
/infrastructure channel unlock
Unlocks the current channel.

websearch.description: Search for information: Wikipedia, Genshin, Steam, YouTube.
websearch.longDescription: Search on Wikipedia, Genshin, Steam, and YouTube profiles.
examples:
/websearch youtube excepterr

wiki.longDescription: Searches for an article on Wikipedia and shows a summary.
examples:
/websearch wiki Discord
Searches for the article "Discord".

genshin.longDescription: Shows the Genshin Impact player profile by UID.

steam.longDescription: Shows the Steam profile by SteamID64 or vanity URL.

youtube.longDescription: Searches for YouTube channels and shows their statistics.
examples:
/websearch youtube excepterr
Searches for the channel "excepterr".

balance.longDescription: Shows balance, level, and available rewards.

timely.description: Claim the regular bonus every 3 hours.

daily.description: Claim the daily bonus every 24 hours.

weekly.description: Claim the weekly bonus every 7 days.

work.description: Work and earn money and experience (every hour).
work.longDescription: Work every hour. Gives money and experience.

bank.description: Bank management: deposit or withdraw money.

remove.description: Remove a role from the shop.

music.longDescription: Music playback and management from YouTube.

examples: /music play never gonna give you up

stop.longDescription: Stops playback and clears the queue.

shuffle.longDescription: Shuffles the tracks in the queue.

8ball.description: Ask the magic 8-ball a question and get an answer.
8ball.question: Question

coinflip.description: Flip a coin: heads or tails.
coinflip.longDescription: Flips a coin and gives heads or tails.

dice.description: Roll a die with the specified number of sides.
dice.longDescription: Rolls a die with the specified number of sides.

rps.longDescription: Plays rock, paper, scissors with the bot.
rps.draw: 🤝 It's a draw! The bot chose **{{bot}}**.

rate.description: Rate something on a scale from 0 to 10.
rate.longDescription: Rates an item or action on a scale from 0 to 10.

length.description: Count characters and words in the text.
